title: Answer: consciousness is subjective experience arising in moments of orchestrated objective reduction

statements.text: Orch OR takes consciousness to be awareness, subjective and phenomenal experience of inner and outer worlds, and grants that what it actually is remains unknown. Its proposal is that consciousness comes in discrete moments, each the end of a biologically orchestrated quantum process in collections of microtubules inside neurons, by the objective reduction of the quantum state. Below it lie unorchestrated reductions, which happen everywhere and carry only an undifferentiated proto-conscious experience, a fundamental feature of spacetime geometry.
statements.scope: the 2014 review Consciousness in the universe

sources.quote: Consciousness implies awareness: subjective, phenomenal experience of internal and external worlds.
But what consciousness actually is remains unknown.
This orchestrated OR activity ('Orch OR') is taken to result in moments of conscious awareness and/or choice.
Such undifferentiated experiences are taken, in the Orch OR scheme, to be irreducible, fundamental features of 'Planck scale geometry'
